scope.purpose: Show a short text about a control when the user points at it or focuses it.
useCases: The keyboard shortcut of an action.
A short clarification of a truncated label.
exclusions: Interactive or essential content: Popover or text on the page.
Rich tooltips with titles or images.

decisionsTaken: Inverse surface (color.surface.inverse, color.content.inverse), typography.caption.md, radius.control, padding space.content.sm × xs, max inline size component.tooltip.max-inline-size (component token, 240 px).
Side top or bottom (what lib/overlay positions today), align center by default; flips and shifts; no arrow.
Hover delay component.tooltip.delay (component token, 500 ms); focus opens at once; once one tooltip is open, the next opens at once.
Accessible description of the trigger, except when the text equals an IconButton's name.
Trigger restricted to Button, IconButton and Link (focusable components); other content gets a Popover or visible text.
nextAction: Documentation review by the user, then the pull request of wave 3 to main.
implementationNotes: The trigger is the first element of the children snippet, wrapped in a display: contents span that listens to pointer and focus events; the tooltip is a manual popover placed by lib/overlay floating.
One tooltip at a time and the skip delay (300 ms after a tooltip closed, the next opens at once) are module-level state.
aria-describedby is added to the trigger unless its aria-label equals the tooltip text.
